Treatment summary
The patient presented with lower back strain following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle was struck on the
driver's side. The mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injury described. Imaging and physical examination
findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the lumbar region. The patient has a remote history of a mionr strain in the same
area, which resolved completely with no residual limitation. Care over 27 visits followed a typical cuorse of manual therapy,
targeted exercise, and anti-inflammatory medication, with visit frequency tapering as function and range of motion improved. At
last review the patient reported near-full return to daily activities, and discharge from active care is anticipated. Two similar
service charges recorded on the same day are currently under routine review for accuracy.
